lessons.title: 9. Embedding Dot Product
lessons.description: Implement `emb_dot(a, b)` for equal-length float lists.
learning_objectives: Score embedding similarity via dot product
lessons.solution_code:
def emb_dot(a, b):
    return sum(x * y for x, y in zip(a, b))

source.name: Dive into Deep Learning §2.3 Linear Algebra — dot product is 'a sum over the products of the elements at the same position'

lessons.title: 11. Top-K Retrieval
lessons.description: Implement `topk(query, corpus, k)` returning indices of k highest dots, highest first.
lessons.solution_code:
def topk(query, corpus, k):
    scored = [(sum(a * b for a, b in zip(query, v)), i) for i, v in enumerate(corpus)]
    scored.sort(key=lambda t: (-t[0], t[1]))
    return [i for _, i in scored[:k]]

source.name: Dive into Deep Learning §2.3 — dot products ranked across vectors

lessons.title: 12. Mean Pool Tokens (Practice)
lessons.solution_code:
def mean_pool(token_vecs):
    dim = len(token_vecs[0])
    n = len(token_vecs)
    return [sum(v[d] for v in token_vecs) / n for d in range(dim)]

source.name: Dive into Deep Learning §2.3 — averaging vectors element-wise

lessons.solution_code:
import math

def softmax(xs):
    m = max(xs)
    exps = [math.exp(x - m) for x in xs]
    s = sum(exps)
    return [e / s for e in exps]

tests.name: test_softmax
tests.unittest_code:
def test_softmax(self):
    out = softmax([0, 0])
    self.assertAlmostEqual(out[0], 0.5)
    self.assertAlmostEqual(sum(softmax([1, 2, 3])), 1.0)
